title: Elite: Contest the Apollo Sun-Clarity Gallery: Relic Detour
description: Elite: Contest the Apollo Sun-Clarity Gallery: Relic Detour is a rebuilt Mythos Gates mission beat for Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial through The Laurel-Sky Gate (Stable Gate with oracle vapor leakage). Your avatar of one selected deity's avatar from Zeus, Artemis, Ares, Athena enters; this beat spotlights Zeus as the reference silhouette while preserving Avatar choice. The mission is the treasure or lore step at Apollo Sun-Clarity Gallery, using floating tribunal arena and oracle theater pacing so shrine, treasure, hazard, elite, and boss reads are route-specific as a finished Mythos Gates campaign beat. Appearance rule: The Celestial Heights of Olympus is the source culture behind later mortal myth echoes; terrain, relics, enemy silhouettes, and rewards must use living marble-light bodies, bronze cuirasses, laurel circuits, aegis scales, thunder tribunal auras, oracle smoke, amphitheater armor curves, hoplite shield geometry, winged victory accents, gold-blue skyfire, carved but non-readable relief bands.
lore: Ascension canon route rewrite: Laurel-Sky Hubris Trial is not a simple portal and not mortal apotheosis. It is a living Mythos Gate route where restored gods and goddesses answer Realm law under Hollow pressure. This mission advances Apollo Sun-Clarity Gallery and reveals: How Olympus tests hubris through terrain law. No armies, squads, or simultaneous party bodies enter standard combat; the route is balanced around one active deity versus many enemies.
terrain: Earth — Ancient Japan, Imperial Shrine. grand corridor of vermilion torii gates now streaked with void-cracks, sacred mirror halls where reflections show the Hollow, bronze ceremonial bells cracked by Gate pressure. Elite Hollow encounter in the avatar's mythological homeland, ancient era.
